## Checklist

- [ ] Theme: `npm run check` passes in `themes/blueline` (if the theme changed)
- [ ] Plugin: `composer test && composer lint` pass in `plugins/blueline-core` (if the plugin changed)
- [ ] `npm run build` run and `assets/dist` committed (if CSS or JS changed)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed behaviour
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an `[Unreleased]` line for anything users will notice
- [ ] No secrets, real host names or IPs, or member data in the diff
